title: Protection paladin: never taunts a mob another tank holds (control)

rules.desc: The Protection paladin casts no Hand of Reckoning on a mob the player tank holds (the mob's victim is the player): LoseAggroTrigger returns false when the victim is a tank player
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:330-343 (LoseAggroTrigger: the victim is a tank player -> false); ai/playerbot/strategy/values/AttackerOfNonTankTargetValue.cpp:44 (hand of reckoning on attacker reads the victim's tank role); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:4026-4047 (IsTank: the forced role decides first); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the player is forced to tank (PlayerbotAI.cpp:4028-4030) and pulls every mob, so every mob's victim is a tank player and both reckoning rows stay silent. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
